stem:
The diagram shows quadrilateral $ABCD$ with all four angles $90^{\circ}$ and side lengths $8$, $5$, $8$, $5$ in order around the shape.

One or more options may be correct. Which two claims are correct?

options.text: It is a rectangle, because all four angles are $90^{\circ}$.
Call it a square as the label, with no check that all sides are equal.
It is not a square, because adjacent sides $8$ and $5$ are unequal.
Having four right angles comes from already calling the shape a square.

teacher.key_rationale: All right angles make a rectangle; unequal adjacent sides mean it is not a square. Calling it a square by label swaps the class. Saying the right angles come from already naming it a square reverses the relation.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source kite as rectangle ABCD with sides 8 and 5 and four right-angle marks.
